definition: experiments/workload.js: four looping mono sample voices through stereo spatial emitters, four-note softKeys chords every beat at 120 BPM through a delay bus, 60 Hz emitter/listener pose updates, 30 Hz meter subscription, a 100 ms JS busy period every second. Stereo mode only (binaural is not implemented). Hosts expose no underrun counter; only engine-side accounting is measured.

browser-600s.host: headless Google Chrome on this Mac, packed consumer build
browser-600s.reason: the harness's original voice bound (4 loops + 8) was wrong: released chord voices remain allocated until the host's ended event, which the busy thread delays, so 16 live voices (4 + 12) is expected behaviour, not a leak; every timing, drop, interruption and cleanup gate was zero. The bound was corrected to 4 + the instrument's polyphony ceiling after this run and the raw payload is kept unchanged.

notCovered: audible dropouts (no counter, no listening/loopback), Firefox and Safari, physical iPhone Safari and Android Chrome, release-mode React Native workload on devices (the phone was disconnected before the lifecycle cycles could run), latency measurement, listening review, usability evaluation.
